posts.title: Crypto market slips as ARC lifts portfolio value
posts.excerpt: Bitcoin traded around $78,040, down 1% over 24 hours, while Ethereum fell 1.5% to roughly $2,458. CoinGabbar's CoinGecko-based market report put total crypto capitalization at $2.76 trillion, down 0.9%, with DeFi dropping 3.8%. The pullback extended beyond the two largest assets, though losses were uneven across sectors. Arbitrum's ARB fell 8.2%, illustrating the sharper losses in parts of the altcoin market.

posts.title: Crypto rebounds as oil tops $100; portfolio reaches $120,580
posts.excerpt: Bitcoin traded around $79,500, up 2.0% over 24 hours, while ether reached roughly $2,516, up 2.3%. The recovery extended beyond the two largest assets: the CoinDesk 20 index was higher, with XRP and Solana also gaining. Crypto was holding up better than European equities despite renewed pressure from energy markets. That divergence describes the session; it does not establish that geopolitical stress caused the crypto rally.
